An '''adamant claymore''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[claymore]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Sword|diamond sword]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It deals 9 damage at an attack speed of 1 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_claymore.json}}</ref>

As a [[claymore]], it is a slow, heavy sword that can also be held up to block attacks like a shield.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. Without the template, the same base and alloy make an [[Adamant Sword|adamant sword]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/adamant/claymore</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===

It deals 9 damage with an attack speed of 1.

Held up with the use button, it blocks 80% of melee damage and 70% of arrow and mob projectile damage, taking a quarter of the blocked damage as durability. Axes disable it for 1 times as long as a shield.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_claymore.json}}</ref>

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Unbreaking]] II
* {{G|Weakness}} Weakness: gives the target Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit, which feeds adamant armor's [[Doom]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>
* [[Sharpness]] I

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_claymore.json}}</ref>
